CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

'=============================================================
' FORM: F_CustomerPO
'
' PURPOSE:
'   Records customer purchase orders received from customers.
'
' IMPORTANT:
'   Vendor on the customer PO means "our company".
'   Therefore, this form does not ask for Vendor.
'
'   This form does NOT move stock.
'   This form does NOT create invoice directly.
'
' REQUIRED MAIN FORM CONTROLS:
'   txtCustomerPOID
'   cboCustomerID
'   txtPONumber
'   txtPODate
'   txtPORevisionDate
'   cboPOType
'   txtPaymentTerms
'   txtShipVia
'   chkPrepaidFreight
'   txtResaleNo
'   txtShipToName
'   txtShipToAddress
'   txtShipToContactName
'   txtShipToPhone
'   txtShipToEmail
'   txtAuthorizedBy
'   txtAuthorizedByEmail
'   txtSubtotalAmount
'   txtMiscChargeAmount
'   txtTaxAmount
'   txtTotalAmount
'   cboPOStatus
'   chkGoodsConfirmed
'   txtGoodsConfirmedOn
'   txtSalesOrderID
'   txtInvoiceID
'   txtSourceFilePath
'   txtNotes
'
' REQUIRED SUBFORM CONTROL NAME:
'   subCustomerPOLines
'
' SUBFORM BEHAVIOUR:
'   The lines subform remains enabled for both new and existing POs.
'   When the user enters it, Access automatically saves a valid PO
'   header first so that CustomerPOID can link the child lines.
'
' REQUIRED BUTTONS:
'   cmdNewPO
'   cmdSavePO
'   cmdConfirmGoods
'   cmdCreateSalesOrder
'   cmdOpenSalesOrder
'   cmdClose
'=============================================================


'=============================================================
' FORM EVENTS
'=============================================================
Private Sub Form_Load()
    UX_MarkRequired Me, "cboCustomerID", "txtPODate"

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    ConfigurePOForm
    ConfigurePOCombos
    SetPODefaultValues
    SetLineSubformAvailability

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The customer PO form could not be loaded." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Customer PO"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Sub Form_Current()

    On Error Resume Next

    SetPODefaultValues
    SetLineSubformAvailability
    RecalculatePOTotals

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    UX_CoerceBooleans Me

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If IsBlankNewPORecord Then
        Me.Undo
        Exit Sub
    End If

    NormalizePOValues

    If Not ValidatePORecord Then
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If Me.NewRecord Then
        SafeSetField "CreatedOn", Now()
    End If

    SafeSetField "UpdatedOn", Now()

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    Cancel = True

    MsgBox _
        "The customer PO could not be validated." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Customer PO Validation"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Sub Form_AfterUpdate()

    On Error Resume Next

    SetLineSubformAvailability

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


'=============================================================
' CONTROL EVENTS
'=============================================================
Private Sub cboCustomerID_AfterUpdate()

    On Error Resume Next

    If IsNull(Me.cboCustomerID) Then Exit Sub

    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToName, vbNullString))) = 0 Then
        Me.txtShipToName = Nz(Me.cboCustomerID.Column(1), vbNullString)
    End If

    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPaymentTerms, vbNullString))) = 0 Then
        Me.txtPaymentTerms = Nz(DLookup( _
            "DefaultPaymentTerms", _
            "T_Customers", _
            "CustomerID = " & CLng(Me.cboCustomerID) _
        ), vbNullString)
    End If

    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipVia, vbNullString))) = 0 Then
        Me.txtShipVia = Nz(DLookup( _
            "DefaultShipVia", _
            "T_Customers", _
            "CustomerID = " & CLng(Me.cboCustomerID) _
        ), vbNullString)
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Sub txtMiscChargeAmount_AfterUpdate()

    RecalculatePOTotals

End Sub


Private Sub txtPONumber_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    'PO number is validated when the record is saved.
    'Do not trap the user in this field while they are still entering the PO.
End Sub




Private Sub txtTaxAmount_AfterUpdate()

    RecalculatePOTotals

End Sub


'=============================================================
' BUTTON EVENTS
'=============================================================

Private Sub cmdSavePO_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If IsBlankNewPORecord Then

        MsgBox _
            "Enter the customer PO details before saving.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Customer PO Required"

        Me.cboCustomerID.SetFocus
        Exit Sub

    End If

    'PO is mandatory for External customers only
    If Nz(DLookup("CustomerType", "T_Customers", _
        "CustomerID=" & Nz(Me.cboCustomerID, 0)), "") = "External" Then

        If Trim(Nz(Me.txtPONumber, "")) = "" Then

            MsgBox _
                "PO Number is required for External customers.", _
                vbExclamation, _
                "PO Required"

            Exit Sub

        End If

    End If

    If Me.Dirty Then
        Me.Dirty = False
    End If

    SetLineSubformAvailability

    If SaveLineSubformIfDirty = False Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    RecalculatePOTotals

    If Me.Dirty Then
        Me.Dirty = False
    End If

    MsgBox _
        "Customer PO saved successfully.", _
        vbInformation, _
        "Customer PO Saved"

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    If Err.Number = 3022 Then

        MsgBox _
            "This PO may already exist for the selected customer." & _
            vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Check the PO number and try again.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Duplicate PO"

    Else

        MsgBox _
            "The customer PO could not be saved." & _
            vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
            "Details: " & Err.Description, _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Customer PO Save Failed"

    End If

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub



Private Sub cmdCreateSalesOrder_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim newSalesOrderID As Long
    Dim existingSalesOrderID As Long
    Dim poID As Long

    poID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)

    If poID <= 0 Then
        MsgBox _
            "Save the customer PO before creating a sales order.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Customer PO Required"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    'Save current PO header only if it is dirty.
    If Me.Dirty Then
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    End If

    'Save current PO line if the user is editing one.
    If SaveLineSubformIfDirty = False Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    RecalculatePOTotals

    If CountPOLines = 0 Then
        MsgBox _
            "Add at least one PO line before creating a sales order.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "No PO Lines"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If Nz(Me.chkGoodsConfirmed, False) = False Then
        MsgBox _
            "Confirm goods before creating the sales order.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Goods Not Confirmed"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    'Check whether a Sales Order already exists.
    existingSalesOrderID = Nz(DLookup( _
        "SalesOrderID", _
        "T_SalesOrders", _
        "CustomerPOID = " & poID _
    ), 0)

    If existingSalesOrderID > 0 Then

        MsgBox _
            "A sales order already exists for this customer PO." & _
            vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "The existing sales order will be opened.", _
            vbInformation, _
            "Sales Order Already Exists"

        Me.Refresh
        OpenSalesOrderByID existingSalesOrderID
        Exit Sub

    End If

    'Create Sales Order using the transaction function.
    newSalesOrderID = CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO()

    If newSalesOrderID <= 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    'Do not manually set txtSalesOrderID/cboPOStatus here.
    'CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO already updates T_CustomerPOs directly.
    'Just refresh the form to pull the updated values from the table.
    Me.Refresh

    MsgBox _
        "Sales order created successfully.", _
        vbInformation, _
        "Sales Order Created"

    OpenSalesOrderByID newSalesOrderID

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The sales order could not be created." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Create Sales Order"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Sub cmdOpenSalesOrder_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim salesOrderIDValue As Long
    Dim poID As Long

    poID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)
    salesOrderIDValue = Nz(Me.txtSalesOrderID, 0)

    If salesOrderIDValue <= 0 And poID > 0 Then
        salesOrderIDValue = Nz(DLookup( _
            "SalesOrderID", _
            "T_SalesOrders", _
            "CustomerPOID = " & poID _
        ), 0)
    End If

    If salesOrderIDValue <= 0 Then

        MsgBox _
            "No sales order has been created for this customer PO yet.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Sales Order Not Found"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    OpenSalesOrderByID salesOrderIDValue

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The sales order could not be opened." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Open Sales Order"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Sub cmdClose_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If Me.Dirty Then
        Me.Dirty = False
    End If

    If SaveLineSubformIfDirty = False Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    DoCmd.close acForm, Me.Name

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The customer PO form could not be closed." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Close Customer PO"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


'=============================================================
' TOTALS
'=============================================================
Public Sub RecalculatePOTotals()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim poID As Long
    Dim subtotalAmountValue As Currency
    Dim miscAmountValue As Currency
    Dim taxAmountValue As Currency
    Dim totalAmountValue As Currency

    poID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)

    If poID <= 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    subtotalAmountValue = Nz(DSum( _
        "Nz([LineSubtotal],0)", _
        "T_CustomerPOLines", _
        "CustomerPOID = " & poID _
    ), 0)

    miscAmountValue = Nz(Me.txtMiscChargeAmount, 0)
    taxAmountValue = Nz(Me.txtTaxAmount, 0)

    totalAmountValue = subtotalAmountValue + miscAmountValue + taxAmountValue

    If Nz(Me.txtSubtotalAmount, 0) <> subtotalAmountValue Then Me.txtSubtotalAmount = subtotalAmountValue
    If Nz(Me.txtTotalAmount, 0) <> totalAmountValue Then Me.txtTotalAmount = totalAmountValue

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "PO totals could not be recalculated." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "PO Totals"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Function CountPOLines() As Long

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0) <= 0 Then
        CountPOLines = 0
    Else
        CountPOLines = Nz(DCount( _
            "*", _
            "T_CustomerPOLines", _
            "CustomerPOID = " & CLng(Me.txtCustomerPOID) _
        ), 0)
    End If

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    CountPOLines = 0

End Function


'=============================================================
' CONFIGURATION

Private Sub ConfigurePOForm()

    On Error Resume Next

    Me.txtCustomerPOID.Visible = False
    Me.txtCustomerPOID.Enabled = False
    Me.txtCustomerPOID.Locked = True

    Me.txtSalesOrderID.Visible = False
    Me.txtInvoiceID.Visible = False

    Me.txtSubtotalAmount.Locked = True
    Me.txtTotalAmount.Locked = True
    Me.txtGoodsConfirmedOn.Locked = True

    Me.txtShipToAddress.EnterKeyBehavior = True
    Me.txtShipToAddress.ScrollBars = 2

    Me.txtNOtes.EnterKeyBehavior = True
    Me.txtNOtes.ScrollBars = 2

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Sub ConfigurePOCombos()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Me.cboCustomerID.RowSourceType = "Table/Query"
    Me.cboCustomerID.RowSource = _
        "SELECT CustomerID, CustomerName " & _
        "FROM T_Customers " & _
        "ORDER BY CustomerName;"

    Me.cboCustomerID.BoundColumn = 1
    Me.cboCustomerID.ColumnCount = 2
    Me.cboCustomerID.ColumnWidths = "0cm;8cm"
    Me.cboCustomerID.LimitToList = True
    Me.cboCustomerID.AutoExpand = True
    Me.cboCustomerID.Requery


    Me.cboPOType.RowSourceType = "Value List"
    Me.cboPOType.RowSource = _
        "Original;" & _
        "Change Order;" & _
        "Revision;" & _
        "Blanket;" & _
        "Release"

    Me.cboPOType.BoundColumn = 1
    Me.cboPOType.ColumnCount = 1
    Me.cboPOType.ColumnWidths = "4cm"
    Me.cboPOType.LimitToList = True
    Me.cboPOType.AutoExpand = True
    Me.cboPOType.Requery


    Me.cboPOStatus.RowSourceType = "Value List"
    Me.cboPOStatus.RowSource = _
        "Received;" & _
        "Goods Confirmed;" & _
        "Sales Order Created;" & _
        "Invoiced;" & _
        "Closed;" & _
        "Cancelled"

    Me.cboPOStatus.BoundColumn = 1
    Me.cboPOStatus.ColumnCount = 1
    Me.cboPOStatus.ColumnWidths = "5cm"
    Me.cboPOStatus.LimitToList = True
    Me.cboPOStatus.AutoExpand = True
    Me.cboPOStatus.Requery

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The customer PO combo boxes could not be loaded." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Customer PO Combos"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Sub SetPODefaultValues()

    On Error Resume Next

    Me.txtPODate.defaultValue = "Date()"
    Me.cboPOType.defaultValue = """Original"""
    Me.cboPOStatus.defaultValue = """Received"""
    Me.chkPrepaidFreight.defaultValue = "False"
    Me.chkGoodsConfirmed.defaultValue = "False"
    Me.txtSubtotalAmount.defaultValue = "0"
    Me.txtMiscChargeAmount.defaultValue = "0"
    Me.txtTaxAmount.defaultValue = "0"
    Me.txtTotalAmount.defaultValue = "0"

    If Me.NewRecord Then

        If IsNull(Me.txtPODate) Then Me.txtPODate = Date
        If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOType, vbNullString))) = 0 Then Me.cboPOType = "Original"
        If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOStatus, vbNullString))) = 0 Then Me.cboPOStatus = "Received"
        If IsNull(Me.chkPrepaidFreight) Then Me.chkPrepaidFreight = False
        If IsNull(Me.chkGoodsConfirmed) Then Me.chkGoodsConfirmed = False
        If IsNull(Me.txtSubtotalAmount) Then Me.txtSubtotalAmount = 0
        If IsNull(Me.txtMiscChargeAmount) Then Me.txtMiscChargeAmount = 0
        If IsNull(Me.txtTaxAmount) Then Me.txtTaxAmount = 0
        If IsNull(Me.txtTotalAmount) Then Me.txtTotalAmount = 0

    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


'=============================================================
' VALIDATION
'=============================================================
Private Sub NormalizePOValues()

    Me.txtPONumber = UCase$(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPONumber, vbNullString)))
    Me.cboPOType = Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOType, vbNullString))
    Me.txtPaymentTerms = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPaymentTerms, vbNullString))
    Me.txtShipVia = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipVia, vbNullString))
    Me.txtResaleNo = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtResaleNo, vbNullString))
    Me.txtShipToName = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToName, vbNullString))
    Me.txtShipToContactName = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToContactName, vbNullString))
    Me.txtShipToPhone = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToPhone, vbNullString))
    Me.txtShipToEmail = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToEmail, vbNullString))
    Me.txtAuthorizedBy = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtAuthorizedBy, vbNullString))
    Me.txtAuthorizedByEmail = Trim$(Nz(Me.txtAuthorizedByEmail, vbNullString))
    Me.cboPOStatus = Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOStatus, vbNullString))

    If IsNull(Me.txtPODate) Then
        Me.txtPODate = Date
    End If

    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOType, vbNullString))) = 0 Then
        Me.cboPOType = "Original"
    End If

    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.cboPOStatus, vbNullString))) = 0 Then
        Me.cboPOStatus = "Received"
    End If

    If IsNull(Me.chkPrepaidFreight) Then
        Me.chkPrepaidFreight = False
    End If

    If IsNull(Me.chkGoodsConfirmed) Then
        Me.chkGoodsConfirmed = False
    End If

    If IsNull(Me.txtMiscChargeAmount) Then
        Me.txtMiscChargeAmount = 0
    End If

    If IsNull(Me.txtTaxAmount) Then
        Me.txtTaxAmount = 0
    End If

End Sub


Private Function ValidatePORecord() As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim currentPOID As Long
    Dim criteriaText As String
    Dim customerTypeValue As String

    ValidatePORecord = False

    currentPOID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' Customer is always required
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    If IsNull(Me.cboCustomerID) Then

        MsgBox _
            "Select the customer.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Customer Required"

        Me.cboCustomerID.SetFocus
        Exit Function

    End If

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' Determine customer type
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    customerTypeValue = Nz(DLookup( _
        "CustomerType", _
        "T_Customers", _
        "CustomerID = " & CLng(Me.cboCustomerID) _
    ), "")

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' PO Number is required ONLY for External customers
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    If StrComp(Trim$(customerTypeValue), "External", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then

        If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPONumber, vbNullString))) = 0 Then

            MsgBox _
                "Enter the customer's PO number." & _
                vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                "PO Number is required for External customers.", _
                vbExclamation, _
                "PO Number Required"

            Me.txtPONumber.SetFocus
            Exit Function

        End If

    End If

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' PO Date is required
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    If IsNull(Me.txtPODate) Then

        MsgBox _
            "Enter the PO date.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "PO Date Required"

        Me.txtPODate.SetFocus
        Exit Function

    End If

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' Duplicate PO check
    ' Only perform it when a PO number has been entered.
    ' Internal customers may legitimately have no PO number.
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    If Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPONumber, vbNullString))) > 0 Then

        criteriaText = _
            "CustomerID = " & CLng(Me.cboCustomerID) & _
            " AND PONumber = " & SqlText(CStr(Me.txtPONumber))

        If currentPOID > 0 Then

            criteriaText = criteriaText & _
                " AND CustomerPOID <> " & currentPOID

        End If

        If DCount("*", "T_CustomerPOs", criteriaText) > 0 Then

            MsgBox _
                "This customer already has a PO with the same PO number." & _
                vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                "Check whether this is a revision/change order or use a different PO number.", _
                vbExclamation, _
                "Duplicate Customer PO"

            Me.txtPONumber.SetFocus
            Exit Function

        End If

    End If

    ValidatePORecord = True

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "PO validation failed." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "PO Validation"

    ValidatePORecord = False
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function

Private Function IsBlankNewPORecord() As Boolean

    If Not Me.NewRecord Then
        IsBlankNewPORecord = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    IsBlankNewPORecord = _
        IsNull(Me.cboCustomerID) And _
        Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtPONumber, vbNullString))) = 0 And _
        Len(Trim$(Nz(Me.txtShipToName, vbNullString))) = 0

End Function


'=============================================================
' SUBFORM HANDLING
'=============================================================
Private Sub SetLineSubformAvailability()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If ControlExists("subCustomerPOLines") Then

        With Me.Controls("subCustomerPOLines")

            .Enabled = True
            .Locked = False

            With .Form
                .AllowAdditions = True
                .AllowEdits = True
                .AllowDeletions = True
            End With

        End With

    End If

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The customer PO lines could not be enabled." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Customer PO Lines"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


Private Function SaveLineSubformIfDirty() As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    SaveLineSubformIfDirty = True

    If Not ControlExists("subCustomerPOLines") Then
        Exit Function
    End If

    With Me.Controls("subCustomerPOLines").Form

        If .Dirty Then
            .Dirty = False
        End If

    End With

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:

    SaveLineSubformIfDirty = False

    MsgBox _
        "The PO line currently being edited could not be saved." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "PO Line Save Failed"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function


'=============================================================
' CUSTOMER PO -> SALES ORDER
'=============================================================
Private Function CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO() As Long

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim db As Object
    Dim wrk As Object

    Dim rsSO As Object
    Dim rsPOLines As Object
    Dim rsSOLines As Object
    Dim rsPOUpdate As Object
    Dim rsPOLineUpdate As Object

    Dim poID As Long
    Dim newSOID As Long
    Dim salesOrderNoValue As String

    Dim qtyValue As Double
    Dim unitPriceValue As Currency
    Dim lineSubtotalValue As Currency
    Dim lineDescriptionValue As String

    Dim transactionStarted As Boolean
    Dim stepName As String

    transactionStarted = False
    stepName = "Starting"

    poID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)

    If poID <= 0 Then
        CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set wrk = DBEngine.Workspaces(0)

    stepName = "Generating sales order number"
    salesOrderNoValue = GetNextDocumentNumberValue("SalesOrder", "SO", 1001, 5)

    stepName = "Starting transaction"
    wrk.BeginTrans
    transactionStarted = True

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 1. Create Sales Order header
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    stepName = "Opening T_SalesOrders"

    Set rsSO = db.OpenRecordset("T_SalesOrders", 2)

    stepName = "Adding sales order header"

    rsSO.addnew

    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "SalesOrderNo", salesOrderNoValue
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "CustomerPOID", poID

    If IsNull(Me.cboCustomerID) Then
        SafeSetRSField rsSO, "CustomerID", Null
    Else
        SafeSetRSField rsSO, "CustomerID", CLng(Me.cboCustomerID)
    End If

    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "OrderDate", Date
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "PaymentTerms", Nz(Me.txtPaymentTerms, vbNullString)
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "ShipVia", Nz(Me.txtShipVia, vbNullString)
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "ShipToName", Nz(Me.txtShipToName, vbNullString)
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "ShipToAddress", Nz(Me.txtShipToAddress, vbNullString)
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "SalesOrderStatus", "Open"
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "Notes", "Created from Customer PO " & Nz(Me.txtPONumber, vbNullString)
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "CreatedOn", Now()
    SafeSetRSField rsSO, "UpdatedOn", Now()

    stepName = "Saving sales order header"

    rsSO.Update
    rsSO.Bookmark = rsSO.LastModified

    If Not RSHasField(rsSO, "SalesOrderID") Then
        Err.Raise 3265, , "T_SalesOrders does not contain SalesOrderID."
    End If

    newSOID = CLng(Nz(rsSO.Fields("SalesOrderID").value, 0))

    If newSOID <= 0 Then
        Err.Raise 5, , "SalesOrderID was not generated."
    End If

    rsSO.close
    Set rsSO = Nothing

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 2. Copy Customer PO lines into Sales Order lines
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    stepName = "Opening customer PO lines"

    Set rsPOLines = db.OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT * FROM T_CustomerPOLines WHERE CustomerPOID = " & poID, _
        2 _
    )

    If rsPOLines.EOF Then
        Err.Raise 3021, , "No customer PO lines were found for this customer PO."
    End If

    stepName = "Opening T_SalesOrderLines"

    Set rsSOLines = db.OpenRecordset("T_SalesOrderLines", 2)

    stepName = "Creating sales order lines"

    Do While Not rsPOLines.EOF

        qtyValue = CDbl(Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "QuantityOrdered", 0), 0))
        unitPriceValue = CCur(Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "UnitPrice", 0), 0))
        lineSubtotalValue = CCur(Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "LineSubtotal", qtyValue * unitPriceValue), qtyValue * unitPriceValue))
        lineDescriptionValue = CStr(Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "LineDescription", vbNullString), vbNullString))

        If Len(Trim$(lineDescriptionValue)) = 0 Then
            lineDescriptionValue = CStr(Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "CustomerPartNumber", vbNullString), vbNullString))
        End If

        rsSOLines.addnew

        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "SalesOrderID", newSOID
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "CustomerPOLineID", RSValue(rsPOLines, "CustomerPOLineID", Null)
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "ItemID", RSValue(rsPOLines, "ItemID", Null)
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "LineDescription", lineDescriptionValue
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "QuantityOrdered", qtyValue
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "QuantityShipped", 0
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "UnitID", RSValue(rsPOLines, "UnitID", Null)
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "UnitPrice", unitPriceValue
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "LineSubtotal", lineSubtotalValue
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "Taxable", Nz(RSValue(rsPOLines, "Taxable", False), False)
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "LineStatus", "Open"
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "CreatedOn", Now()
        SafeSetRSField rsSOLines, "UpdatedOn", Now()

        rsSOLines.Update

        rsPOLines.MoveNext

    Loop

    rsPOLines.close
    Set rsPOLines = Nothing

    rsSOLines.close
    Set rsSOLines = Nothing

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 3. Update Customer PO header
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    stepName = "Updating customer PO header"

    Set rsPOUpdate = db.OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT * FROM T_CustomerPOs WHERE CustomerPOID = " & poID, _
        2 _
    )

    If Not rsPOUpdate.EOF Then

        rsPOUpdate.Edit

        SafeSetRSField rsPOUpdate, "SalesOrderID", newSOID
        SafeSetRSField rsPOUpdate, "POStatus", "Sales Order Created"
        SafeSetRSField rsPOUpdate, "UpdatedOn", Now()

        rsPOUpdate.Update

    End If

    rsPOUpdate.close
    Set rsPOUpdate = Nothing

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 4. Update Customer PO lines
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    stepName = "Updating customer PO lines"

    Set rsPOLineUpdate = db.OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT * FROM T_CustomerPOLines WHERE CustomerPOID = " & poID, _
        2 _
    )

    Do While Not rsPOLineUpdate.EOF

        rsPOLineUpdate.Edit

        SafeSetRSField rsPOLineUpdate, "LineStatus", "Sales Order Created"
        SafeSetRSField rsPOLineUpdate, "UpdatedOn", Now()

        rsPOLineUpdate.Update
        rsPOLineUpdate.MoveNext

    Loop

    rsPOLineUpdate.close
    Set rsPOLineUpdate = Nothing

    '---------------------------------------------------------
    ' 5. Commit transaction
    '---------------------------------------------------------
    stepName = "Committing transaction"

    wrk.CommitTrans
    transactionStarted = False

    CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO = newSOID

Exit_Handler:

    On Error Resume Next

    If Not rsSO Is Nothing Then rsSO.close
    If Not rsPOLines Is Nothing Then rsPOLines.close
    If Not rsSOLines Is Nothing Then rsSOLines.close
    If Not rsPOUpdate Is Nothing Then rsPOUpdate.close
    If Not rsPOLineUpdate Is Nothing Then rsPOLineUpdate.close

    Set rsSO = Nothing
    Set rsPOLines = Nothing
    Set rsSOLines = Nothing
    Set rsPOUpdate = Nothing
    Set rsPOLineUpdate = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    Set wrk = Nothing

    On Error GoTo 0

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:

    Dim realErrNumber As Long
    Dim realErrDescription As String
    Dim realStepName As String

    realErrNumber = Err.Number
    realErrDescription = Err.Description
    realStepName = stepName

    On Error Resume Next

    If transactionStarted Then
        wrk.Rollback
        transactionStarted = False
    End If

    If Not rsSO Is Nothing Then rsSO.close
    If Not rsPOLines Is Nothing Then rsPOLines.close
    If Not rsSOLines Is Nothing Then rsSOLines.close
    If Not rsPOUpdate Is Nothing Then rsPOUpdate.close
    If Not rsPOLineUpdate Is Nothing Then rsPOLineUpdate.close

    On Error GoTo 0

    MsgBox _
        "The sales order transaction could not be completed." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Failed Step: " & realStepName & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & realErrNumber & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & realErrDescription, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Sales Order Creation Failed"

    CreateSalesOrderFromCurrentPO = 0
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function


Private Sub OpenSalesOrderByID(ByVal salesOrderIDValue As Long)

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If salesOrderIDValue <= 0 Then

        MsgBox _
            "No valid Sales Order ID was provided.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Open Sales Order"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    If Not FormExists("F_SalesOrders") Then

        MsgBox _
            "The form F_SalesOrders was not found. Check the sales order form name.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Form Not Found"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    DoCmd.OpenForm _
        "F_SalesOrders", _
        acNormal, _
        , _
        "SalesOrderID = " & salesOrderIDValue

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The sales order could not be opened." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Open Sales Order"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub


'=============================================================
' DOCUMENT NUMBERING
'=============================================================
Private Function GetNextDocumentNumberValue( _
    ByVal documentTypeValue As String, _
    ByVal defaultPrefix As String, _
    ByVal defaultNextNumber As Long, _
    ByVal defaultNumberLength As Long _
) As String

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim db As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim sqlLookup As String

    Dim prefixValue As String
    Dim nextNumberValue As Long
    Dim numberLengthValue As Long

    Set db = CurrentDb

    sqlLookup = _
        "SELECT * FROM T_DocumentNumbers " & _
        "WHERE DocumentType = '" & Replace(documentTypeValue, "'", "''") & "';"

    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(sqlLookup, 2)

    If rs.EOF Then

        prefixValue = defaultPrefix
        nextNumberValue = defaultNextNumber
        numberLengthValue = defaultNumberLength

        rs.addnew

        rs.Fields("DocumentType").value = documentTypeValue
        rs.Fields("Prefix").value = prefixValue
        rs.Fields("NextNumber").value = nextNumberValue + 1
        rs.Fields("NumberLength").value = numberLengthValue
        rs.Fields("LastUpdatedOn").value = Now()

        rs.Update

    Else

        prefixValue = Nz(RSValue(rs, "Prefix", defaultPrefix), defaultPrefix)
        nextNumberValue = CLng(Nz(RSValue(rs, "NextNumber", defaultNextNumber), defaultNextNumber))
        numberLengthValue = CLng(Nz(RSValue(rs, "NumberLength", defaultNumberLength), defaultNumberLength))

        rs.Edit

        SafeSetRSField rs, "NextNumber", nextNumberValue + 1
        SafeSetRSField rs, "LastUpdatedOn", Now()

        rs.Update

    End If

    GetNextDocumentNumberValue = _
        prefixValue & Format(nextNumberValue, String(numberLengthValue, "0"))

Exit_Handler:

    On Error Resume Next

    If Not rs Is Nothing Then
        rs.close
    End If

    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing

    On Error GoTo 0

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:

    GetNextDocumentNumberValue = _
        defaultPrefix & Format(Now(), "yyyymmddhhnnss")

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function


'=============================================================
' SAFE HELPERS
'=============================================================
Private Sub SafeSetField(ByVal fieldName As String, ByVal fieldValue As Variant)

    On Error Resume Next
    Me(fieldName) = fieldValue
    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Function ControlExists(ByVal controlName As String) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim ctl As Control

    Set ctl = Me.Controls(controlName)
    ControlExists = True

Exit_Handler:
    Set ctl = Nothing
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    ControlExists = False
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function


Private Function SqlText(ByVal value As String) As String

    SqlText = "'" & Replace(value, "'", "''") & "'"

End Function


Private Function RSHasField(ByVal rs As Object, ByVal fieldName As String) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim i As Long

    For i = 0 To rs.Fields.Count - 1

        If StrComp(rs.Fields(i).Name, fieldName, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
            RSHasField = True
            Exit Function
        End If

    Next i

    RSHasField = False
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    RSHasField = False

End Function


Private Function RSValue(ByVal rs As Object, ByVal fieldName As String, ByVal defaultValue As Variant) As Variant

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    If RSHasField(rs, fieldName) Then

        If IsNull(rs.Fields(fieldName).value) Then
            RSValue = defaultValue
        Else
            RSValue = rs.Fields(fieldName).value
        End If

    Else

        RSValue = defaultValue

    End If

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    RSValue = defaultValue

End Function


Private Sub SafeSetRSField(ByVal rs As Object, ByVal fieldName As String, ByVal fieldValue As Variant)

    On Error Resume Next

    If RSHasField(rs, fieldName) Then
        rs.Fields(fieldName).value = fieldValue
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0

End Sub


Private Function FormExists(ByVal formName As String) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim obj As AccessObject

    For Each obj In CurrentProject.AllForms

        If StrComp(obj.Name, formName, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
            FormExists = True
            Exit Function
        End If

    Next obj

    FormExists = False

Exit_Handler:
    Set obj = Nothing
    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    FormExists = False
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function
Private Sub cmdConfirmGoods_Click()

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim poID As Long

    poID = Nz(Me.txtCustomerPOID, 0)

    If IsBlankNewPORecord Or poID <= 0 Then

        MsgBox _
            "Save the customer PO before confirming goods.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Customer PO Required"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    If Me.Dirty Then
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    End If

    If SaveLineSubformIfDirty = False Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If CountPOLines = 0 Then

        MsgBox _
            "Add at least one PO line before confirming goods.", _
            vbExclamation, _
            "No PO Lines"

        Exit Sub

    End If

    RecalculatePOTotals

    If CanConfirmGoodsForPO(poID, True) = False Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Me.chkGoodsConfirmed = True
    Me.txtGoodsConfirmedOn = Now()
    Me.cboPOStatus = "Goods Confirmed"

    If Me.Dirty Then
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSaveRecord
    End If

    MsgBox _
        "Goods have been confirmed for this customer PO." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "You can now create the sales order.", _
        vbInformation, _
        "Goods Confirmed"

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:

    MsgBox _
        "The goods confirmation could not be completed." & _
        vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
        "Details: " & Err.Description, _
        vbExclamation, _
        "Confirm Goods"

    Resume Exit_Handler

End Sub
Private Function CanConfirmGoodsForPO( _
    ByVal customerPOIDValue As Long, _
    ByVal showReport As Boolean _
) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim db As Object
    Dim rsLines As Object

    Dim itemIDValue As Variant
    Dim lineDescriptionValue As String

    Dim qtyRequiredValue As Double
    Dim qtyOnHandValue As Double
    Dim qtyReservedValue As Double
    Dim qtyAvailableValue As Double

    Dim stockLineCount As Long
    Dim serviceLineCount As Long
    Dim shortageCount As Long

    Dim reportText As String
    Dim lineText As String

    CanConfirmGoodsForPO = False

    Set db = CurrentDb

    Set rsLines = db.OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT * FROM T_CustomerPOLines WHERE CustomerPOID = " & customerPOIDValue, _
        2 _
    )

    If rsLines.EOF Then

        If showReport Then
            MsgBox _
                "This customer PO has no lines.", _
                vbExclamation, _
                "No PO Lines"
        End If

        GoTo Exit_Handler

    End If

    reportText = "Goods Confirmation Check" & vbCrLf & String(45, "-") & vbCrLf

    Do While Not rsLines.EOF

        itemIDValue = RSValue(rsLines, "ItemID", Null)
        lineDescriptionValue = CStr(Nz(RSValue(rsLines, "LineDescription", vbNullString), vbNullString))
        qtyRequiredValue = CDbl(Nz(RSValue(rsLines, "QuantityOrdered", 0), 0))

        If Len(Trim$(lineDescriptionValue)) = 0 Then
            lineDescriptionValue = CStr(Nz(RSValue(rsLines, "CustomerPartNumber", vbNullString), vbNullString))
        End If

        If IsNull(itemIDValue) Or Nz(itemIDValue, 0) <= 0 Then

            serviceLineCount = serviceLineCount + 1

            lineText = "NON-STOCK / SERVICE LINE: " & lineDescriptionValue & vbCrLf
            lineText = lineText & "No ItemID linked, so no stock check is needed." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

            reportText = reportText & lineText

        Else

            stockLineCount = stockLineCount + 1

            qtyOnHandValue = GetTotalOnHandForPOItem(CLng(itemIDValue))
            qtyReservedValue = GetTotalReservedForPOItem(CLng(itemIDValue))
            qtyAvailableValue = qtyOnHandValue - qtyReservedValue

            If qtyAvailableValue >= qtyRequiredValue Then

                lineText = "OK: " & lineDescriptionValue & vbCrLf
                lineText = lineText & _
                    "Required: " & qtyRequiredValue & _
                    ", Available: " & qtyAvailableValue & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

            Else

                shortageCount = shortageCount + 1

                lineText = "SHORTAGE: " & lineDescriptionValue & vbCrLf
                lineText = lineText & _
                    "Required: " & qtyRequiredValue & _
                    ", Available: " & qtyAvailableValue & _
                    ", Short By: " & (qtyRequiredValue - qtyAvailableValue) & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

            End If

            reportText = reportText & lineText

        End If

        rsLines.MoveNext

    Loop

    If stockLineCount = 0 And serviceLineCount > 0 Then

        CanConfirmGoodsForPO = True
        reportText = reportText & "Result: All lines are non-stock/service lines. Goods can be confirmed."

    ElseIf shortageCount = 0 Then

        CanConfirmGoodsForPO = True
        reportText = reportText & "Result: Stock is available. Goods can be confirmed."

    Else

        CanConfirmGoodsForPO = False
        reportText = reportText & "Result: Goods cannot be confirmed because some items have shortages."

    End If

    If showReport Then
        MsgBox reportText, vbInformation, "Goods Confirmation Check"
    End If

Exit_Handler:

    On Error Resume Next

    If Not rsLines Is Nothing Then
        rsLines.close
    End If

    Set rsLines = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing

    On Error GoTo 0

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:

    If showReport Then

        MsgBox _
            "Goods confirmation stock check failed." & _
            vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
            "Error Number: " & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
            "Details: " & Err.Description, _
            vbExclamation, _
            "Goods Confirmation Check"

    End If

    CanConfirmGoodsForPO = False
    Resume Exit_Handler

End Function


Private Function GetTotalOnHandForPOItem(ByVal itemIDValue As Long) As Double

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    GetTotalOnHandForPOItem = Nz(DSum( _
        "Nz([QuantityOnHand],0)", _
        "T_StockBalances", _
        "ItemID = " & itemIDValue _
    ), 0)

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    GetTotalOnHandForPOItem = 0

End Function


Private Function GetTotalReservedForPOItem(ByVal itemIDValue As Long) As Double

    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    GetTotalReservedForPOItem = Nz(DSum( _
        "Nz([QuantityReserved],0)", _
        "T_StockBalances", _
        "ItemID = " & itemIDValue _
    ), 0)

    Exit Function

Err_Handler:
    GetTotalReservedForPOItem = 0

End Function

Private Sub cboCustomerID_NotInList(NewData As String, Response As Integer)
    On Error GoTo Err_Handler
    Response = acDataErrContinue
    If HandleComboNotInList(Me.cboCustomerID, NewData, "F_CustomerSetup", "T_Customers", "CustomerID", "CustomerName", "CustomerCode") Then
        Response = acDataErrAdded
    Else
        Me.cboCustomerID.Undo
    End If
    Exit Sub
Err_Handler:
    Response = acDataErrContinue
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Add Customer"
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Error(DataErr As Integer, Response As Integer)
    Dim uxHandled As Boolean
    UX_SuppressFormError DataErr, Response, uxHandled
    If uxHandled Then Exit Sub
    Response = acDataErrDisplay
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
    On Error Resume Next
    If Me.NewRecord And Me.Dirty Then Me.Undo
End Sub
